description: Apple's unauthenticated Search API searches the iTunes Store and Apple Books Store across documented media types, including music, movies, podcasts, audiobooks, TV shows, software, and ebooks. It supports term searches and ID-based lookups and returns JSON metadata such as artwork, previews, and store links, subject to Apple's promotional-content terms. It is distinct from the authenticated Apple Music API.
resolution_notes: Description: corrected. Apple's current official page identifies the searchable catalogs as the iTunes Store and Apple Books Store, not the Apple Music catalog, and documents JSON results, media types, ID lookups, artwork, previews, and store links: https://performance-partners.apple.com/search-api. Apple's separate Apple Music API requires developer-token authorization: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applemusicapi/generating-developer-tokens
